entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh yeah. You ready for tomorrow?
What?
Tomorrow?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: White Day. That's tomorrow, right?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You got some chocolates on Valentine's[n]Day, didn't you?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And White Day's when you return the[n]favor. The men do the gifting.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You, uh... You had kind of a rough[n]Valentine's Day.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: So now you got a chance to redeem[n]yourself.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What's your plan? You've at least got[n]some kinda present ready, right?
I forgot...
What should I do...?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Get it together, kid... Sometimes I don't[n]know if you're fearless or just plain[n]careless.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Fine. Listen up, and I'll give you the[n]recipe for the ultimate date.
That'd be great.
Thanks.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa, the chief has an ultimate date plan?[n]I better listen in too, just in case.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: First off... You're gonna need a gift.[n]This won't work without one.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Can't go wrong with flowers. Just make[n]sure you buy them before the date.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You gotta present them near the end.[n]Surprise her. So you can't let her see[n]you buying them on the date, got it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Aha... Gotta give them flowers, huh?[n]I gotta take notes...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Next, think about where you're taking[n]her.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You're gonna want somewhere with[n]the right atmosphere, but it's gotta be[n]peaceful...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, how about that new aquarium[n]exhibit in Shinagawa? Just saw a[n]commercial for it.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Might be a good spot, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The aquarium's a good place for a[n]date... I see.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Now, once the date part's over, you gotta[n]take her out to dinner. Somewhere[n]nice, too.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: But it's kind of last-minute to make[n]reservations. All the fancy places get[n]booked pretty fast around White Day.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay, right, too late to make any[n]reservations—wait, what!?
Any way around that?
I'm screwed...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Dammit. I don't usually do this,[n]but... I know a place.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Can't guarantee anything. I bet they're[n]full up, too. But you might get an edge[n]if you mention my name.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wow, amazing! Chief has connections!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: So once you're at dinner, you get to[n]talking, enjoying yourselves...[n]That's when you give it to her.
The flowers...
The bill...
Give her what...?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Good, you were paying attention.[n]It's the perfect time to surprise her.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa, are you sure about that?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: There's something you gotta give her,[n]and it sure as hell isn't the bill.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: The flowers. Remember? We covered[n]this before?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You need that surprise gift.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Weren't you listening? I'm talking[n]about the flowers.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You need that surprise gift.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...That oughta do it. Just follow the plan,[n]and you're safe.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wow! This plan is foolproof![n]Leave it to the chief!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well, I taught you my secrets. The rest[n]is on you. Do your prep, and make[n]those reservations.
Got it.
Thanks.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Good luck.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: On that note, I'm going home.[n]Now it's up to you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You should start prepping right away.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't waste the chief's advice, all right?
